The documentation encodes three distinct "no verdict" states — the secret step's source=None, its api_key=None, and the models step's selected_models=None — whose prior conflation caused a Critical config-destroying bug (an already-enabled, keyless provider getting force-disabled because a SECRET_KEEP no-op was misread as an explicit "disabled"). Revisit only if the decision itself grows new branches.

complexity.counting_convention: Authoritative rule is the one bootstrapper/tests/test_maintenance_baseline.py implements; match it exactly when refreshing. Scope: every non-hidden *.py under bootstrapper/ and services/backend/app/app/ (591 files at this refresh) — the leading-dot filter is what excludes bootstrapper/.venv, and an unfiltered glob inflates every count roughly 20x. radon_grade_c_or_worse counts blocks with complexity >= 11 EXCLUDING radon class blocks (block.letter != "C"), because a class block aggregates its own methods and would double-count the symbol-level baseline; counting class blocks too yields 429 rather than 428. Function span is physical lines (end_lineno - lineno + 1). Parameter count is posonly + args + kwonly + *args + **kwargs, counting self/cls. modules_over_600_logical_lines uses radon raw lloc, not a hand-rolled non-blank/non-comment count (21 under Radon's logical-line rule at this refresh). Note that signal_thresholds.cyclomatic_complexity (12) is the review-signal bar from the maintenance spec and is deliberately NOT the counter bound: radon_grade_c_or_worse counts grade C upward, which begins at 11.
